Desc.SourceString: <!>支线测试装备
Desc.LocalizedString: <!>支线测试装备

Desc.SourceString: 装备者施加「赤焰」时，转为施加「白焰圣火」。全队施加的「白焰圣火」的伤害触发间隔缩短50%。
Desc.LocalizedString: Converts Crimson Flame inflicted by the wearer into White Lightflame. Reduces allies' White Lightflame damage trigger interval by 50%.

Desc.SourceString: 装备者施加「赤焰」时，转为施加「蚀焰印记」。全队引爆「蚀焰印记」并同时击杀多个目标时，将根据击杀目标数量永久提升「蚀焰印记」伤害，每个目标提升0.5%。
Desc.LocalizedString: Converts Crimson Flame inflicted by the wearer into Eclipseflame Mark. Increases Eclipseflame Mark DMG permanently by 0.5% for each target defeated when allies detonate Eclipseflame Mark and defeat multiple targets at the same time.

Desc.SourceString: 全队攻击带有「赤焰」的目标时，回复3点充能值，此效果冷却时间为1秒。
Desc.LocalizedString: Restores 3 Charge when allies attack a target with Crimson Flame. Cooldown: 1s.

Desc.SourceString: 「赤焰」持续时间延长10秒；装备者所有攻击有50%概率为目标施加「赤焰」。
Desc.LocalizedString: Extends Crimson Flame duration by 10s. Gives all of the wearer's attacks a 50% chance to inflict Crimson Flame on the target.

Desc.SourceString: 装备者所有攻击有50%概率为目标施加「赤焰」；全队施加的「赤焰」持续时间结束时，对目标造成300%倍率伤害。
Desc.LocalizedString: There's a 50% chance for the wearer's attacks to inflict Crimson Flame on the target. Deals 300% DMG to the target when Crimson Flame inflicted by allies ends.

Desc.SourceString: 装备者施加「赤焰」时，转为施加「白焰圣火」。全队施加「白焰圣火」时，施加层数翻倍。
Desc.LocalizedString: Converts Crimson Flame inflicted by the wearer into White Lightflame. Doubles the number of stacks applied when allies inflict White Lightflame.

Desc.SourceString: 装备者施加「赤焰」时，转为施加「蚀焰印记」。全队施加「蚀焰印记」时，为目标附加攻击力降低30%、抗性降低20%、防御降低30%三个减益效果之一。
Desc.LocalizedString: Converts Crimson Flame inflicted by the wearer into Eclipseflame Mark. Inflicts one of the following debuffs on the target when allies inflict Eclipseflame Mark: ATK -30%, Resistance -20%, or DEF -30%.

Desc.SourceString: 全队攻击带有「赤焰」的目标时，回复全队3%生命值，此效果冷却时间为1秒。
Desc.LocalizedString: Restores 3% HP to allies when they attack a target with Crimson Flame. Cooldown: 1s.

Desc.SourceString: 全队受到的「赤焰」和「怪物灼烧」效果转为生命回复；装备者释放极轨终结时，为全队成员和目标施加「赤焰」。
Desc.LocalizedString: Converts Crimson Flame and Monster Burn on allies into HP Recovery. Applies Crimson Flame to allies and the target when the wearer casts Ultimate.

Desc.SourceString: 装备者释放极轨终结时，为目标施加「赤焰」。全队施加的「赤焰」持续时间结束时，对目标造成300%倍率的伤害，并回复生命值。
Desc.LocalizedString: Inflicts Crimson Flame on the target when the wearer casts Ultimate. Deals 300% DMG to the target and restores allies' HP when Crimson Flame inflicted by allies ends.

Desc.SourceString: 真红释放极轨终结为目标施加「赤焰」时，转为施加「白焰圣火」。
Desc.LocalizedString: Inflicts White Lightflame instead of Crimson Flame when Shinku's Ultimate would inflict Crimson Flame on a target.

Desc.SourceString: 真红发动闪避为目标施加「赤焰」时，转为施加「蚀焰印记」。
Desc.LocalizedString: Inflicts Eclipseflame Mark instead of Crimson Flame when Shinku's Dodge would inflict Crimson Flame on a target.

Desc.SourceString: 真红受到的「赤焰」伤害降低80%；驻场时，抗打断能力提升，防御力提升800%。
Desc.LocalizedString: Reduces Crimson Flame DMG taken by Shinku by 80%. While active, increases Resistance to Interruptions and increases DEF by 800%.

Desc.SourceString: 真红攻击带有「赤焰」的目标时，回复3点「桀骜斗志」。
Desc.LocalizedString: Restores 3 Defiant Spirit when Shinku attacks a target affected by Crimson Flame.

Desc.SourceString: 「威慑凝视」状态下，真红移动速度提升50%；发动闪避时造成100%倍率伤害，并为范围内目标施加「赤焰」。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases Shinku's Movement Speed by 50% while she's in Menacing Gaze state. Deals 100% DMG and inflicts Crimson Flame on targets in range when she Dodges.

Desc.SourceString: 装备者施加「赤焰」时，转为施加「白焰圣火」。目标拥有「白焰圣火」时受到的伤害提升300%。
Desc.LocalizedString: Converts Crimson Flame inflicted by the wearer into White Lightflame. DMG taken by targets afflicted with White Lightflame increases by 300%.

Desc.SourceString: 装备者施加「赤焰」时，转为施加「蚀焰印记」。全队引爆「蚀焰印记」时，可斩杀生命值低于15%的目标。
Desc.LocalizedString: Converts Crimson Flame inflicted by the wearer into Eclipseflame Mark. Executes targets below 15% HP when allies detonate Eclipseflame Mark.

Desc.SourceString: 全队攻击带有「赤焰」的目标时，暴击伤害提升600%。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases allies' Crit DMG by 600% when they attack targets marked with Crimson Flame.

Desc.SourceString: 全队攻击带有「赤焰」的目标时，暴击伤害提升300%。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases allies' Crit DMG by 300% when they attack targets marked with Crimson Flame.

Desc.SourceString: 全队龙炎能叠加更多层数，自身释放大招和长按普攻为目标施加龙炎
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases the stack limit for Dragonflame inflicted by allies. Inflicts Dragonflame on the target with the wearer's Ultimate and charged Basic Attacks.

Desc.SourceString: 全队施加的「赤焰」持续时间结束时，扣除目标6点倾陷值。
Desc.LocalizedString: Reduces the target's Break by 6 when Crimson Flame inflicted by allies ends.

Desc.SourceString: 全队引爆「蚀焰印记」后，为目标施加「白焰圣火」。此效果冷却时间为1秒。
Desc.LocalizedString: Inflicts White Lightflame on the target after allies detonate Eclipseflame Mark. Cooldown: 1s.

Desc.SourceString: 全队施加的「白焰圣火」持续时间结束时，为目标施加「蚀焰印记」。此效果冷却时间为1秒。
Desc.LocalizedString: Inflicts Eclipseflame Mark on the target when White Lightflame inflicted by allies ends. Cooldown: 1s.

Desc.SourceString: 全队施加「白焰圣火」时，有10%概率触发「爆燃」。目标每拥有1层「白焰圣火」，受到20%*层数的倍率伤害。
Desc.LocalizedString: When any team member inflicts White Lightflame, there is a 10% chance to trigger Blastfire, dealing DMG equal to 20% ATK per stack of White Lightflame on the target.

Desc.SourceString: 全队引爆「蚀焰印记」后，再次为目标施加「蚀焰印记」。
Desc.LocalizedString: Reinflicts Eclipseflame Mark on the target after allies detonate Eclipseflame Mark.

Desc.SourceString: 装备者每隔3秒，对大范围内目标施加「白焰圣火」，此效果后台生效。
Desc.LocalizedString: Applies White Lightflame to targets in a large area every 3s, even while the wearer is off-field.

Desc.SourceString: 全队引爆「蚀焰印记」时，每有1个「蚀焰印记」的目标，引爆伤害提升40%。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases Detonation DMG by 40% for each target with Eclipseflame Mark when allies trigger its detonation.

Desc.SourceString: 全队施加「白焰圣火」层数时，为范围内所有拥有「白焰圣火」的目标额外施加1层。
Desc.LocalizedString: Inflicts 1 additional White Lightflame stack on all targets within range that already have White Lightflame whenever allies apply White Lightflame stacks.

Desc.SourceString: 全队为目标施加减益效果时，对所有带有「蚀焰印记」的目标施加相同减益效果。
Desc.LocalizedString: Applies the same debuff to all targets with Eclipseflame Mark when allies inflict a debuff on a target.

Desc.SourceString: 装备者身上的「赤焰」不会消失；释放变轨技能时，同步全队成员与范围内目标的「白焰圣火」最高层数。
Desc.LocalizedString: Prevents the wearer's Crimson Flame from disappearing. Casting a Redirect Skill synchronizes White Lightflame stacks among all allies and targets within range, matching them to the highest current stack count.

Desc.SourceString: 全队为已有「蚀焰印记」的目标再次施加「蚀焰印记」时，额外附加1个减益效果。
Desc.LocalizedString: Inflicts 1 additional debuff when an ally reapplies Eclipseflame Mark to a target already affected by it.

Desc.SourceString: 装备者受到的「赤焰」伤害降低80%；处于前台时，防御力提升500%，攻击力提升900%。
Desc.LocalizedString: Reduces the wearer's Crimson Flame DMG taken by 80%. While the wearer is active, increases DEF by 500% and ATK by 900%.

Desc.SourceString: 装备者受到的「赤焰」伤害降低80%；处于前台时，防御力提升500%，攻击力提升900%。
Desc.LocalizedString: Reduces the wearer's Crimson Flame DMG taken by 80%. While the wearer is active, increases DEF by 500% and ATK by 900%.

Desc.SourceString: 真红攻击带有「白焰圣火」的目标时，必定造成暴击。
Desc.LocalizedString: Guarantees Shinku's attacks are Critical Hits when attacking targets afflicted with White Lightflame.

Desc.SourceString: 真红释放极轨终结时，立即结算目标身上的所有「白焰圣火」伤害。
Desc.LocalizedString: Settles all White Lightflame DMG on the target immediately when Shinku casts her Ultimate.

Desc.SourceString: 装备者处于「威慑凝视」状态时，每秒回复自身25%生命值；结束「威慑凝视」状态时，引爆所有「蚀焰印记」。
Desc.LocalizedString: Restores 25% HP every second while the wearer is in Menacing Gaze state. Detonates all Eclipseflame Marks when Menacing Gaze state ends.

Desc.SourceString: 带有「蚀焰印记」的目标数量越多，真红发动闪避施加「蚀焰印记」的范围越大。
Desc.LocalizedString: Expands the area where Shinku's Dodge applies Eclipseflame Mark based on the number of targets with Eclipseflame Mark.

Desc.SourceString: 全队施加的「白焰圣火」叠加层数无上限。
Desc.LocalizedString: Removes the stack limit for White Lightflame inflicted by allies.

Desc.SourceString: 全队引爆「蚀焰印记」时，额外扣除目标1.5%生命值。
Desc.LocalizedString: Reduces the target's HP by an additional 1.5% when allies detonate Eclipseflame Mark.

Desc.SourceString: 全队施加的「白焰圣火」可蔓延至相邻目标。
Desc.LocalizedString: Allows White Lightflame inflicted by allies to spread to nearby targets.

Desc.SourceString: 全队施加的「蚀焰印记」击杀目标时，为其相邻目标施加「蚀焰印记」，并使接下来5秒内的引爆伤害提升300%。
Desc.LocalizedString: Applies Eclipseflame Mark to nearby targets when a target with Eclipseflame Mark inflicted by allies is defeated. Increases detonation DMG by 300% for the next 5s.

Desc.SourceString:
伊洛伊小羊们的攻击有25%的几率会给目标施加「梦羊」 ，同时每只小羊施加「梦羊」时会造成额外200%倍率的伤害 。
初始「梦羊」：怪物抗性减少5%，持续2秒，至多叠加5层。
Desc.LocalizedString:
There's a 25% chance that Iroi's sheep attacks inflict Dreamwool on the target. Each sheep deals 200% additional DMG when inflicting Dreamwool.
Default Dreamwool: Reduces the monster's Resistance by 5% for 2s, up to 5 stacks.

Desc.SourceString: 概率提升至75%，伤害倍率提升至200%。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases the chance to 75% and the DMG Ratio to 200%.

Desc.SourceString: 方塔苏斯的攻击有20%的几率给命中的敌人「噪声」：每秒受到40%攻击倍率的伤害，持续5秒，至多叠加3层。
Desc.LocalizedString: There's a 20% chance for Phantasos's attacks to inflict Noise on enemies hit. Noise Effect: Deals damage equal to 40% of ATK every second for 5s, up to 3 stacks.

Desc.SourceString: 莫尔甫斯的攻击有25%的几率会给全队施加「鼓吹」：攻击提升1.6%，持续5秒，至多叠10层。
Desc.LocalizedString: There's a 25% chance for Morpheus's attacks to grant allies Rally. Rally Effect: Increases ATK by 1.6% for 5s, up to 10 stacks.

Desc.SourceString: 伊刻洛斯的每次暴击会给目标施加「破甲」：每层减少10%的怪物抗性，至多叠5层。
Desc.LocalizedString: Inflicts Armor Break on the target with each Critical Hit from Icelos. Each stack reduces the monster's Resistance by 10%, up to 5 stacks.

Desc.SourceString: 伊刻洛斯的每次有50%的几率会斩杀血量低于15%最大生命值的怪物，最高伤害500000点。
Desc.LocalizedString: There's a 50% chance for each of Icelos's attacks to execute monsters below 15% Max HP, up to 500,000 DMG.

Desc.SourceString:
零的所有攻击会给目标施加「梦羊」，每层「梦羊」会额外减少怪物1.8%的抗性。
初始「梦羊」：怪物抗性减少5%，持续2秒，至多叠加5层。
Desc.LocalizedString:
Causes all of Esper Zero's attacks to inflict Dreamwool on the target. Each stack of Dreamwool additionally reduces the monster's Resistance by 1.8%.
Default Dreamwool: Reduces the monster's Resistance by 5% for 2s, up to 5 stacks.

Desc.SourceString: 每层「梦羊」会额外减少怪物3.2%的抗性。
Desc.LocalizedString: Each stack of Dreamwool additionally reduces the monster's Resistance by 3.2%.

Desc.SourceString: 全队的生命值提升21%。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases allies' HP by 21%.

Desc.SourceString: 全队的防御力提升30%。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases allies' DEF by 30%.

Desc.SourceString: 全队的生命值提升36%，每有一只小羊在场会额外提升7%的生命值。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases allies' HP by 36%. Further increases their HP by 7% for each active lamb.

Desc.SourceString: 全队的防御力提升48%，每有一只小羊在场会额外提升8%的防御力。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases allies' DEF by 48%. Further increases their DEF by 8% for each active lamb.

Desc.SourceString:
薄荷释放大招和长按普攻「梦羊」，「梦羊」的持续时间增加1秒，每层额外减少怪物1%的抗性。
初始「梦羊」：怪物抗性减少5%，持续2秒，至多叠加5层。
Desc.LocalizedString:
Applies Dreamwool to targets when Mint uses her Ultimate and charged Basic Attacks. Increases Dreamwool's duration by 1s. Each stack additionally reduces the monster's Resistance by 1%.
Default Dreamwool: Reduces the monster's Resistance by 5% for 2s, up to 5 stacks.

Desc.SourceString: 「梦羊」的持续时间增加2秒，每层额外减少怪物2%的抗性。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases Dreamwool's duration by 2s. Each stack additionally reduces the monster's Resistance by 2%.

Desc.SourceString: 全队的攻击力提升15%。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases allies' ATK by 15%.

Desc.SourceString: 全队的伤害提升14% 。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases allies' DMG dealt by 14%.

Desc.SourceString: 全队的攻击力提升24%，每有一只小羊在场攻击力额外提升5%。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases allies' ATK by 24%. Further increases their ATK by 5% for each active lamb.

Desc.SourceString: 全队的伤害提升20%，每有一只小羊在场伤害额外提升4%。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases allies' DMG dealt by 20%. Further increases their DMG dealt by 4% for each active lamb.

Desc.SourceString:
真红大招、技能和极限闪避为目标施加「梦羊」，「梦羊」的持续时间增加1秒，每层额外减少怪物1%的抗性。
初始「梦羊」：怪物抗性减少5%，持续2秒，至多叠加5层。
Desc.LocalizedString:
Applies Dreamwool to targets when Shinku uses her Ultimate, Skill, or Critical Dodge. Increases Dreamwool's duration by 1s. Each stack additionally reduces the monster's Resistance by 1%.
Default Dreamwool: Reduces the monster's Resistance by 5% for 2s, up to 5 stacks.

Desc.SourceString: 「梦羊」的持续时间增加2秒，每层额外减少怪物2%的抗性。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases Dreamwool's duration by 2s. Each stack additionally reduces the monster's Resistance by 2%.

Desc.SourceString: 全队无视怪物3%的防御力。
Desc.LocalizedString: Causes allies' attacks to ignore 3% of the monster's DEF.

Desc.SourceString: 全队的暴击伤害提升13.5%。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases allies' Crit DMG by 13.5%.

Desc.SourceString: 全队无视怪物9%的防御力，每有一只小羊额外无视2%的防御力。
Desc.LocalizedString: Causes allies to ignore 9% of monsters' DEF and grants them an additional 2% DEF Ignore for each active lamb.

Desc.SourceString: 全队的暴击伤害提升30%，每有一只小羊暴击伤害额外提升5.5%。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases allies' Crit DMG by 30%. Further increases allies' Crit DMG by 5.5% for each active lamb.

Desc.SourceString: 方塔苏斯普攻间隔减少0.8秒，普攻倍率增加600%。
Desc.LocalizedString: Reduces Phantasos's Basic Attack interval by 0.8s and increases its Basic Attack Ratio by 600%.

Desc.SourceString: 方塔苏斯普攻间隔减少1.2秒，普攻倍率增加2000%。
Desc.LocalizedString: Reduces Phantasos's Basic Attack interval by 1.2s and increases its Basic Attack Ratio by 2,000%.

Desc.SourceString: 莫尔甫斯普攻间隔减少0.4秒，普攻倍率增加200%
Desc.LocalizedString: Reduces Morpheus's Basic Attack interval by 0.4s and increases its Basic Attack Ratio by 200%.

Desc.SourceString: 莫尔甫斯普攻间隔减少0.6秒，普攻倍率增加500%
Desc.LocalizedString: Reduces Morpheus's Basic Attack interval by 0.6s and increases its Basic Attack Ratio by 500%.

Desc.SourceString: 方塔苏斯每次普攻会发射2道音波，且伤害的范围增加。
Desc.LocalizedString: Causes each of Phantasos's Basic Attacks to fire 2 sonic waves and have an increased damage area.

Desc.SourceString: 莫尔甫斯每次普攻会额外发射2发子弹，且削韧效果增强。
Desc.LocalizedString: Causes each of Morpheus's Basic Attacks to fire 2 additional bullets and enhances Tenacity Break.

Desc.SourceString: 队伍中角色对挂有「梦羊」的目标施加攻击时，有20%的几率给全队施加「牧歌」：暴击伤害提升40%，持续3秒，至多叠加3层。
Desc.LocalizedString: There's a 20% chance to apply Pastorale to all allies when an ally attacks a target with Dreamwool. Pastorale Effect: Increases Crit DMG by 40% for 3s, up to 3 stacks.

Desc.SourceString: 「牧歌」施加的暴击伤害提升至120%。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases the Crit DMG bonus granted by Pastorale to 120%.

Desc.SourceString: 队伍中角色对挂有「梦羊」的目标施加攻击时，有10%的几率给全队施加「夜曲」：伤害提升21%，持续3秒，至多叠加2层。
Desc.LocalizedString: There's a 10% chance to apply Nocturne to all allies when an ally attacks a target with Dreamwool. Nocturne Effect: Increases DMG dealt by 21% for 3s, up to 2 stacks.

Desc.SourceString: 「夜曲」施加的伤害提升提升至40%。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases the DMG bonus granted by Nocturne to 40%.

Desc.SourceString: 怪物被施加「梦羊」时有30%的概率额外被施加「灼火」：每秒受到施加者166%攻击力的伤害，持续5秒，至多叠加3层。
Desc.LocalizedString: There's a 30% chance to also inflict Scorchfire when Dreamwool is inflicted on a monster. Scorchfire Effect: Deals damage equal to 166% of the caster's ATK every second for 5s, up to 3 stacks.

Desc.SourceString: 怪物被施加「梦羊」时有40%的概率额外被施加「绵软」：防御力和攻击力减少15%，持续5秒，至多叠加3层。
Desc.LocalizedString: There's a 40% chance to also inflict Softy when Dreamwool is inflicted on a monster. Softy Effect: Reduces DEF and ATK by 15% for 5s, up to 3 stacks.

Desc.SourceString: 队伍中角色受到治疗时，有30%的几率给该角色施加「曦风」：伤害提升50%，持续5秒，至多叠加3层。
Desc.LocalizedString: There's a 30% chance to apply Dawnwind to an ally when they are healed. Dawnwind Effect: Increases DMG dealt by 50% for 5s, up to 3 stacks.

Desc.SourceString: 概率提升至50%，且「曦风」还会使攻击力60%，暴击伤害提升100%。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases the chance to 50%. Dawnwind also increases ATK by 60% and Crit DMG by 100%.

Desc.SourceString: 队伍中角色对怪物造成暴击时，有5%的几率对目标施加「猎标」：持续5秒，至多叠加10层。「猎标」达到10层或怪物死亡时，造成【80000+30000*层数】的范围伤害并清除标记。
Desc.LocalizedString: There's a 5% chance to inflict Hunter's Mark on the target for 5s when an ally lands a Critical Hit on a monster. Hunter's Mark stacks up to 10 times. Deals AoE DMG equal to (80,000 + 30,000 × stacks) and clears the mark at 10 stacks or when the monster is defeated.

Desc.SourceString: 「猎标」造成的范围伤害会给命中的目标额外施加2层「猎标」。爆炸的伤害提升400% 。
Desc.LocalizedString: Inflicts 2 additional stacks of Hunter's Mark on targets hit by Hunter's Mark AoE DMG and increases Explosion DMG by 400%.

Desc.SourceString: 队伍中角色造成暴击时，有50%的几率回复全队角色3000+15%最大生命的生命值，并施加「朔风」：攻击力增加100% ，持续5秒。
Desc.LocalizedString: There's a 50% chance to restore 3000 + 15% Max HP to allies and grant them Northwind when an ally lands a Critical Hit. Northwind Effect: Increases ATK by 100% for 5s.

Desc.SourceString: 队伍中角色的每次普攻都会给全队施加「虹色」：增加1.25%的攻击力，持续3秒，至多叠加100层。
Desc.LocalizedString: Grants allies Iridescence each time an ally performs a Basic Attack. Iridescence Effect: Increases ATK by 1.25% for 3s, up to 100 stacks.

Desc.SourceString: 队伍中角色击杀带有「梦羊」的目标的敌人后，有30%的几率给全队施加「引光」：暴击提升3%，持续3秒，至多叠加3层。
Desc.LocalizedString: There's a 30% chance to apply Lightcalling to allies when an ally defeats a target with Dreamwool. Lightcalling Effect: Increases Crit Chance by 3% for 3s, up to 3 stacks.

Desc.SourceString: 「引光」施加的暴击提升提升至10%。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases the Crit Chance bonus granted by Lightcalling to 10%.

Desc.SourceString: 队伍中角色对带有「梦羊」的目标的敌人造成暴击后，有20%的几率给全队施加「坠星」：攻击力提升25%，持续3秒，至多叠加3层。
Desc.LocalizedString: There's a 20% chance to apply Falling Star to allies when an ally lands a Critical Hit on a target with Dreamwool. Falling Star Effect: Increases ATK by 25% for 3s, up to 3 stacks.

Desc.SourceString: 「坠星」施加的攻击力提升至75%。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases the ATK bonus granted by Falling Star to 75%.

Desc.SourceString: 队伍中角色每击杀一个敌人，给全队施加「流云」：伤害提升12.5%，持续5秒，至多叠加10层。
Desc.LocalizedString: Grants Flowing Cloud to allies each time an ally defeats an enemy. Flowing Cloud Effect: Increases DMG dealt by 12.5% for 5s, up to 10 stacks.

Desc.SourceString: 队伍中角色造成暴击时，给全队施加「红月」暴击伤害提升12%，持续3秒，至多叠加10层。
Desc.LocalizedString: Grants Red Moon to allies when an ally lands a Critical Hit. Red Moon Effect: Increases Crit DMG by 12% for 3s, up to 10 stacks.

Desc.SourceString: 投掷骰子时，点数增加10点
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases dice roll points by 10.

Desc.SourceString: 装备者的移速提升50%。该效果全队唯一生效，不可叠加。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases the wearer's Movement Speed by 50%. This effect only applies once across the entire team and does not stack.

Desc.SourceString: 装备者的耐力消耗减少50%。该效果全队唯一生效，不可叠加。
Desc.LocalizedString: Reduces the wearer's Stamina Cost by 50%. This effect only applies once across the entire team and does not stack.

Desc.SourceString: 装备者释放极轨终结时，全队获得装备者50%最大生命值的护盾，持续12秒
Desc.LocalizedString: Grants allies a shield equal to 50% of the wearer's Max HP for 12s when the wearer casts their Ultimate.

Desc.SourceString: 全队每有一个角色处于满生命值状态，全队伤害提升20%。每有一个角色阵亡，全队伤害降低20%。该效果全队唯一生效，不可叠加。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases allies' DMG by 20% for each ally at full HP. Reduces allies' DMG by 20% for each fallen ally. This effect only applies once across the entire team and does not stack.

Desc.SourceString: 装备者进入战斗后，每秒提升50%防御力，上限提升至500%。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases the wearer's DEF by 50% every second after they enter battle, up to 500%.

Desc.SourceString: 装备者的移速降低60%，无法使用冲刺，每秒回复自身20%最大生命值
Desc.LocalizedString: Reduces the wearer's Movement Speed by 60%, disables the Dash, and restores 20% of their Max HP per second.

Desc.SourceString: 装备者复活时，获得200%攻击力提升和200%伤害提升，持续5秒。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases the wearer's ATK by 200% and DMG dealt by 200% for 5s when they are resurrected.

Desc.SourceString: 全队造成的伤害提升80%，防御力降低80%
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases allies' DMG dealt by 80%, while decreasing their DEF by 80%.

Desc.SourceString: 装备者释放变轨技能时，召唤一个漩涡，持续牵引周围敌人。该效果冷却时间为6秒。该效果全队唯一生效，不可叠加。
Desc.LocalizedString: Summons a vortex that continuously pulls in nearby enemies when the wearer casts a Redirect Skill. Cooldown: 6s. This effect only applies once across the entire team and does not stack.

Desc.SourceString: 装备饰品时，全队免疫红雾造成的伤害
Desc.LocalizedString: Grants allies immunity to Red Mist DMG when this Accessory is equipped.

Desc.SourceString: 装备饰品时，全队免疫怪物灼烧造成的伤害
Desc.LocalizedString: Grants allies immunity to Monster Burn DMG when this Accessory is equipped.

Desc.SourceString: 装备者对目标造成伤害时，对附近范围目标造成一段25%倍率的溅射伤害，此效果冷却时间为0.25秒。
Desc.LocalizedString: Deals 1 instance of Splash DMG to nearby targets at a 25% ratio when the wearer deals damage to a target. Cooldown: 0.25s.

Desc.SourceString: 食用采集物时不会受到减益效果影响。装备者受到的所有药水效果大幅提升，且药水效果持续时间延长。
Desc.LocalizedString: Grants the wearer immunity to debuffs when consuming gathered items. Greatly enhances all potion effects on the wearer and extends their duration.

Desc.SourceString: 装备者每拥有1个药水增益效果，自身攻击力提升20%。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases ATK by 20% for each Potion Buff active on the wearer.

Desc.SourceString: 被变为「绵绵」的目标，抗性降低100%，持续30秒。
Desc.LocalizedString: Reduces the Resistance of targets morphed into Fuzzy by 100% for 30s.

Desc.SourceString: 装备者释放极轨终结命中目标时，将目标变为「绵绵」，持续5秒。每场战斗仅生效1次。
Desc.LocalizedString: Morphs the target into Fuzzy for 5s when the wearer's Ultimate hits. Triggers once per battle.

Desc.SourceString: 装备者每次对目标造成伤害时，附加1层「疾风」标记。标记持续3秒，上限10层。累计至上限时清空「疾风」层数并对大范围目标造成800%倍率的伤害，此效果冷却时间为2秒。
Desc.LocalizedString: Applies 1 stack of Gale Mark each time the wearer deals damage to a target. Gale Mark lasts 3s, up to 10 stacks. Clears all Gale Mark stacks when they reach the limit and deals 800% DMG to all targets in a large area. Cooldown: 2s.

Desc.SourceString: 装备者每次对目标造成伤害时，附加1层「疾风」标记。标记持续3秒，上限10层。目标生命值低于50%时，清空「疾风」层数并对大范围目标造成800%倍率的伤害，此效果冷却时间为2秒。
Desc.LocalizedString: Applies 1 stack of Gale Mark each time the wearer deals damage to a target. Gale Mark lasts 3s, up to 10 stacks. Clears all Gale Mark stacks and deals 800% DMG to all targets in a large area when the target is below 50% HP. Cooldown: 2s.

Desc.SourceString: 装备者受到致命伤害时，将保留1点生命值并进入持续5秒的假死状态，该效果冷却时间为60秒。假死期间，角色无法切换入场。若该角色为队伍中唯一存活成员，则会倒地且无法移动，并在假死状态结束时回复自身30%生命值。
Desc.LocalizedString: Leaves the wearer at 1 HP and causes them to enter Feigned Death for 5s when they take a fatal hit. Cooldown: 60s. While in Feigned Death, the character cannot be switched in. If the wearer is the only surviving member, they collapse and cannot move, then recover 30% HP when Feigned Death ends.

Desc.SourceString: 从其他角色切换至装备者时，装备者变为「暗黑咩」状态，并被所有怪物视为友方单位，不会受到其主动攻击。装备者主动攻击或切换角色时，退出「暗黑咩」状态。
Desc.LocalizedString: Causes the wearer to enter Shadow Fuzzy state when switching to the wearer from another character. While in Shadow Fuzzy state, all monsters treat the wearer as an ally and will not attack them first. The wearer exits Shadow Fuzzy state after attacking or switching characters.

Desc.SourceString: 可替代任意一个装备部件，用于激活套装效果。
Desc.LocalizedString: Replaces any one equipment piece to activate Set Effects.

Desc.SourceString: 装备者每击杀1个目标，自身变轨技能与极轨终结冷却时间减少0.5秒。该效果冷却时间为1秒。该效果全队唯一生效，不可叠加。
Desc.LocalizedString: Reduces the cooldowns of the wearer's Redirect Skill and Ultimate by 0.5s for each enemy they defeat. Cooldown: 1s. This effect only applies once across the entire team and does not stack.

Desc.SourceString: 装备者每次造成伤害时有50%概率释放「电荷」，对范围内多个目标造成1800%倍率的伤害。该效果冷却时间为1.5秒。
Desc.LocalizedString: There's a 50% chance to release Charge each time the wearer deals damage, dealing 1800% DMG to multiple targets in range. Cooldown: 1.5s.

Desc.SourceString: 「电荷」命中目标时，对其施加强控效果，持续0.5秒。此效果对Boss不生效。
Desc.LocalizedString: Inflicts hard crowd control for 0.5s when Charge hits a target. Not effective against Bosses.

Desc.SourceString: 装备者受到伤害时，自身防御力提升100%，最多提升700%；同时有50%概率对攻击者施加强控效果（对Boss不生效），持续1秒，并对自身周围目标造成伤害并造成一次1000%倍率伤害。该效果冷却时间为3秒。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases the wearer's DEF by 100% when they take damage, up to 700%. Also has a 50% chance to apply hard crowd control (not effective against Bosses) to the attacker for 1s, deal DMG to targets around the wearer, and deal 1000% DMG once. Cooldown: 3s.

Desc.SourceString: 装备者释放极轨终结后，对大范围内目标施加缓速效果，持续10秒。该效果冷却时间为60秒。
Desc.LocalizedString: Inflicts Slow on targets within a large area for 10s after the wearer casts Ultimate. Cooldown: 60s.

Desc.SourceString: 装备者可释放特殊极轨终结。
Desc.LocalizedString: Allows the wearer to cast a special Ultimate.

Desc.SourceString: 装备者生命值低于50%时，造成的伤害提升200%。
Desc.LocalizedString: Increases the wearer's DMG dealt by 200% when their HP is below 50%.

Desc.SourceString: 以身为剑，划破黎明。
Desc.LocalizedString: With body forged as blade, cleave the coming dawn.

Desc.SourceString: 要听听吗？沃伦大陆之外的歌谣。
Desc.LocalizedString: Lend an ear—a ballad drifts from beyond the Warren Continent.

Desc.SourceString: 自由的风，是抓不住的。
Desc.LocalizedString: No chain can bind the wind of freedom.

Desc.SourceString: 或许，赤龙也可以是屠龙勇士。
Desc.LocalizedString: Perhaps even the Crimson Dragon may rise as a dragonslayer.

Desc.SourceString: 装备者攻击时，能听到塔吉多的声音。
Desc.LocalizedString: Allows the wearer to hear Taygedo's voice when they attack.
